newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ceramiche Ricchetti '96 div 50 lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ceramiche Ricchetti '96 div 50 lire.

text.p: Italy's Gruppo Ceramiche Ricchetti, quoted on the Milan bourse since September, said it proposed paying a 1996 dividend of 50 lire per share.

The Modena-based company, a leading producer of glazed tiles, announced last month it had posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 9.0 billion lire against 4.2 billion on turnover of 251.5 billion lire versus 274.4 billion.
It said in a statement the company's 1997 budget forecast increased turnover, a further increase in profitability, with a target return on equity of 15 percent, and a reduction in net debt.
